column1: # HardwareOne recovery-OTA layout for 16 MB FeatherS3 boards without ESP-SR.
# Migration to this layout is cable-only and relocates LittleFS. Back up data
# before first flash. Subsequent OTA writes touch ota_0 and otadata only.
# factory:  golden pure-IDF recovery updater (1336 KiB)
# otadata:  two-sector ESP-IDF OTA selection journal
# 2026-08-16: ota_0 grown +512K (0x80000) at littlefs's expense to restore
#             app-partition headroom (was ~2% free). 512K not 500K: app partition
#             offsets must stay 64K-aligned. littlefs OFFSET MOVES -> the data
#             partition is REFORMATTED on the first flash after this change.
